$comment: Contract for data/tables/drawer_comparisons.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js; what a comparison must be by build/src/registry.js (REGISTRY-COMPARISON).
title: Drawer comparisons
description: One row per comparison the material drawer draws (D133, D139): a closed heading on its tab in which the headlines that name it (headline_definitions.csv, Drawer comparison) are drawn product by product, those of one unit on one scale, with every record of the properties they read, and of the properties it lists, under it. The row holds the words that belong to the whole comparison; its caption is the method.csv rule of Section Comparison and the same Topic.

fields.name: Comparison
fields.description: The comparison's name, which is its heading in the drawer and the Topic of its caption in method.csv.

fields.name: About
fields.description: The title of the closed line under the graphs that holds the caption and the headlines' comparison notes: what a reader who asks how the tests differ opens.

fields.name: Pair label
fields.description: Where each unit's two headlines are one test on two kinds of bar or two tests a product may publish both of, the label of the line naming the products that publish both ("Both tests", "Both orientations"); "No product publishes" and its lower-cased words say there are none. Not applicable: the comparison draws no such line.

fields.name: Listed properties
fields.description: Properties of the comparison's tab whose records the heading lists under it, each in its own block with its documents, without drawing them: another endpoint of the same test, too seldom published, or with no orientation stated, to stand on a scale beside the headlines (tensile strain at strength under the tensile tests, D140). Not applicable: none.

fields.name: Note topic
fields.description: A Topic of method.csv, Section Comparison, shown as a second closed line under the heading: the Topic its title, the rule its text (how flexural and tensile results relate, D140). Not applicable: none.
